about:
Saffron Road is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, and was founded in 2010 by Adnan Durrani, a 30-year veteran of the organic food sector. Durrani launched the brand nationally in July 2010 at Whole Foods Market as the world's first Halal-certified, antibiotic-free, and humanely raised frozen entrée line, aiming to create a premium better-for-you brand that honored environmental, farmer, animal, and health standards without compromising taste.

The company produces a range of globally inspired frozen meals, snacks, and sauces, including frozen dinners with at least 50% more chicken or lamb, crunchy chickpea snacks, single-serve simmer sauces, and frozen world-cuisine wraps. Its product portfolio spans over six world cuisines and is positioned as the fastest-growing natural frozen entrée brand and the leading chickpea snack brand in the natural channel. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed in the available information.

Saffron Road's products are sold through major natural and conventional grocery retailers such as Whole Foods Market, Target, Sprouts Farmers Market, and Safeway, reaching consumers seeking clean-label, ethically sourced convenience foods. Customer testimonials cite purchases at these retailers across states including Texas, California, Georgia, Virginia, New York, and Florida.

The brand differentiates itself through a stated "zero tolerance" policy on ingredient compromise: no seed oils, artificial ingredients, hormones, GMOs, or antibiotics; humanely raised and grass-fed meats; and certifications including USDA Organic, Halal (IFANCA), Kosher, Non-GMO Project Verified, Gluten-Free, and Seed Oil Free. The company frames its mission as connecting cultures through food while maintaining purpose beyond profit.
